title: a16z Podcast: Data Down on the Farm

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Farmers are among the best hackers in the business.
reader_summary.overview: Farmers are among the best hackers in the business. They can fix anything, and are endlessly tweaking their approach to a business that is up against the strongest force on the planet: nature. As adopters of technology, the agriculture industry is both forward-thinking and, at the same time, hard to convince to make a change.

key_points.text: For good reason -- you can’t A/B-test an almond orchard.
You get one shot a year to grow a crop and make a profit.
So whatever technology makes its way into the fields had better work.
